environment.note: data.gov.in and kstrc.karnataka.gov.in were unreachable from the build sandbox on 2026-10-22; see failed_attempts below.

datasets.name: BMTC GTFS (static)
datasets.provider: Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation, via the DULT Transport Data Hub; mirrored by Vonter/bmtc-gtfs (scraped from the official Namma BMTC app)
datasets.license: Open data / CC-BY-4.0 style attribution requested by upstream; BMTC is the data owner. See ATTRIBUTATIONS in the feed.
datasets.used_for: route graph, stop coordinates, trip sequences, fare stages
datasets.caveat: Upstream mirrors what the Namma BMTC app exposes; only routes with live tracking are present, and stop timings can drift.

datasets.name: BMRCL / Namma Metro GTFS
datasets.provider: Bengaluru Metro Rail Corporation, via the DULT Transport Data Hub; mirrored by Vonter/bmrcl-gtfs
datasets.license: Open data; BMRCL is the data owner
datasets.used_for: metro legs, station access (entrances/pathways), metro fares
datasets.caveat: Intermediate stop times are approximated from BMRCL timetable images and stop spacing, not official per-stop timings.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap — Bengaluru / Kanakapura corridor extract
datasets.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API
datasets.used_for: campus/landmark geocoding, metro entrances, corridor bus stops
datasets.caveat: OSM coverage of individual college gates is uneven; every place is snapped to the nearest official GTFS stop before routing.

datasets.name: Karnataka transport / KSRTC corridor data (curated)
datasets.provider: Curated by CampusTransit from KSRTC fare table reproduced by Star of Mysore (2025-01-05) and The Indian Express (2025-01-05)
datasets.used_for: KSRTC intercity leg on the Kanakapura Road / Harohalli corridor
datasets.caveat: data.gov.in was unreachable during the build (HTTP 503 / no DNS). Only two fares are published numbers; the Harohalli fare is an explicitly-labelled interpolation.
